slides.say: When a provider gets a different value, React re-renders every component that reads that context below it.

slides.text: React compares the old and new value with Object.is.
slides.say: React decides whether the value changed by comparing the old and new value with Object dot is.
Watch out with objects. This value is a brand new object every time MyApp renders. So every reader re-renders, even if user did not change.

slides.text: memo can’t block it: readers still get fresh context.
slides.say: And wrapping children in memo does not stop it. Components that read the context still receive the fresh value.
